note: Every creature card (live and pool) tagged by theme and by animal, and proposed later variants (status "proposed"; not in cards.json). body = stats without skills; skills are applied in the post-balance step. A proposed variant is player-obtainable (variant.audience "player"): its body comes from the budget N of its rarity, Lumber and Wait (tools/skill_costs.js), its name is a thematic proposal (nameProposal; internalName is the Dire / Elder id name) and variant.multDraft is the old multiplier draft. Non-player units (the raid's boss units, raid bosses) keep multipliers: nonPlayer. Picks per map: the hub's db, collection unitPicks (tools/hub/pull_unit_picks.md).

vocab.variantStats: player variants: N-based (bodyFromN); non-player units: nonPlayerMult

subtypes.label: Ghost: a wraith, wisp or shade of the restless dead
Spirit: a shrine spirit, a candle-keeper, a shadow-thing
Elemental: fire, water, air, storm, stone or ice given an animal shape
Undead: bones and revenants that stood back up
Construct: a golem, a summoned shield, an iron warden
Structure: a building that fights (a hill, a hive, a dam, a gate)
Fiend: imps, devils and the things the Ashen Choir calls up
Conjured: a plague creature summoned out of nothing (Frog, Fly)
Plant: an ent, a vine, a walking willow
Mythic: a great beast of the old songs (dragons, the leviathan, the dragon-turtle)
Changeling: wears whatever shape you hoped for
Were-beast: a creature that becomes more of itself at night
Mutant: changed by the glow or the high ground
